arithmetic: Total on-farm depletion implied by report = 132,620 / 0.10 = 1,326,200 AF. Max if every acre the report deems treatable by full-season fallow were fallowed: 353,995 ac x 1.504 AF/ac = 532,400 AF = 40% of on-farm depletion.

The report's own treatable-acreage bound for fallowing implies ~40% of agricultural depletion is reachable by the deepest practical response; a charge could in principle reach further (other crops, deficit irrigation), so 0.6 is above that bound but within 0.3-0.8.
